questions.answer: On campus

questions.answer: the international dormitory

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: they had meal plans but we didn't get those and we actually had a kitchen at the global dorm but never cooked there as it was located in the next building

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer:
there is a curfew 1-5am and you get penalty if you come home at that time there are also other rules u must follow butm otherwise is ok
and you need to buy a lot of things for you room so be prepared to spend money and have many big bags of stuff

questions.answer: the first time i did registered it was a bit confusing because i didn't know where to press but  the second time it was easy

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: you get to register before the other students and u have like 2-3 days to register so if you did not get the class you wanted on the first try theres a chance you can get it the next day as they only open few spots a day.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: our buddy

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: i got all of the classes i wanted but not in first try

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: dont stress too much and choose the classes you want the most first i guess... and have the subject codes ready for an easy copy and paste it saves time

after getting arc make a bankaccount
